QUOTE: "Two options, and the compile-time one wins if both are present (platform.c:16–19)." and "Enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` and define both `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO`" and "Enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` without the macros. Then call once... `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(my_calloc, my_free)`"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer pair. But it says the compile-time one "wins if both are present", which is precedence, not mutual exclusivity. It also tells the reader to enable the runtime option "without the macros".
